lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You hear about the family out past the third fern cluster?

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Packed up. Gone. In the night. Didn't even tell the neighbors. That's how you know things are bad.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I used to collect the big spotted ferns for decoration. Now I can't even look at them without my stomach doing something unpleasant.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I keep my doors locked now. I know it doesn't help against half the things out there, but it helps against the feeling, and sometimes that's enough.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: My uncle says it was quieter before.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: My uncle also says a lot of things. But on this one, I believe him.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Some people say we should push back. Into the jungle, I mean. Reclaim the outer paths.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Those people do not have children, I've noticed.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: We get travelers through here sometimes.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Most of them look worse on the way back than they did on the way in.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You're not the first to ignore that pattern.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You look like you've slept outdoors recently.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I mean that as an observation, not a compliment.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The jungle creatures don't really have a language.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: It's more of a… vibrational intention.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: And the intention is almost always the same.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I tried talking to one of the jungle things once.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Diplomatically.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: It did not receive the gesture diplomatically.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The jungle looks beautiful from here.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: That's intentional, I think. It wants you to walk into it.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: My advice? Stick to the paths where you can hear yourself think.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The moment the jungle gets loud, stop moving. When it goes quiet again, run.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You're not the first stranger who looked at me like I was being overly cautious. Most of those strangers came back.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: A few did not.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You're the alien, right? The one everyone's been whispering about?

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You look less impressive in person. I mean that affectionately.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Word is you actually talked to a Son of Mars without it ending in someone being unconscious.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I'd like to hear that story when you have time.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You're really going after the Lich?

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Just... the Lich?

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The actual Lich?

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: ...Okay. Sure.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I'll be rooting for you from inside this building with the door locked.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I heard you fought your way through the dark zones. I've never been in the dark zones.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I've never wanted to be in the dark zones.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I hope it was worth it.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The jungle gave us everything once. Food, shade, building material. It still gives us those things.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: It also tries to eat us now.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The relationship has become complicated.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The elders say the creatures changed after the first signs appeared in the sky.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I don't know what that means.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: I don't think the elders know either.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: They say it very confidently, though.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: We've tried to relocate twice. Both times we came back. The jungle is home. You don't abandon home just because home is trying to kill you.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: ...That sounded more reasonable before I said it out loud.
